review.tagline: Agent Skills that steer AI coding agents toward better frontend design
review.summary: A set of SKILL.md files that give coding agents rules for layout, typography, motion and spacing, plus image-generation skills for web, mobile and brand-kit reference boards. The default skill exposes three 1-10 dials (DESIGN_VARIANCE, MOTION_INTENSITY, VISUAL_DENSITY). Installs with `npx skills add` or as a Claude Code plugin; also usable in Codex and Cursor.
review.audience: Developers who use coding agents to build frontends and want less generic UI
strengths: Installs per skill via `npx skills add --skill <name>` or as a Claude Code plugin
Three adjustable dials in the default skill: variance, motion intensity, visual density
Separate skills for redesign, minimalist, brutalist, soft UI and image-to-code workflows
Framework agnostic; rules target design intent rather than one framework API
weaknesses: Default taste-skill v2 is marked experimental and not yet at a stable 2.0.0
Image-generation skills need a separate generator such as ChatGPT Images
No published releases; output quality depends on the agent and model used
README gives no benchmarks or measured results, only one example screenshot
needs: Needs npx skills CLI, Codex, Cursor or Claude Code, ChatGPT Images or similar (image skills only)
Models: Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT
